pages.description: The pages of the sheet, in print order.

guides.description: The guide lines on every page, in mm: `x` for the upright lines, `y` for the flat ones, each from the paper's edge.

grid.description: The grid's cell on every page in mm. 0 for no grid.

landscape.description: Lays the A4 sheet on its side, 297 by 210 mm, for every page that has no format of its own. Left out, upright.

words.description: The sheet's Lernwörter (words to learn), one to a line as typed. Left out, the sheet has none.

breaks.description: The word breaks set by hand for the whole sheet: each word in lower case, with the places it breaks at, as counts of characters. Left out, the module's own breaks apply.

on.description: Whether page numbers print at all. Left out, they do not.

at.description: Where the number prints: "bottom" centred at the foot, "right" at the foot's right, "outer" at the outer foot corner (left on even pages, right on odd), "top" at the top right. Left out, "bottom".

form.description: How the number reads: "n" for 2, "seite" for Seite 2, "of" for 2 / 5, "seiteVon" for Seite 2 von 5. Left out, "n".

notFirst.description: Leaves the number off the first page. Left out, the first page is numbered.

black.description: Prints the number in black. Left out, it is grey.

pageNumbers.description: The page numbers printed on each page. Left out, none are printed.

blocks.description: The blocks printed on this page, drawn in order.

guides.description: The page's own guide lines in mm, beside the sheet's. Left out, the page has none of its own.

grid.description: The grid's cell on this page in mm, in place of the sheet's. 0 for no grid. Left out, the sheet's grid applies.

landscape.description: Lays this page on its side, 297 by 210 mm, in place of the sheet's format. Left out, the sheet's format applies.

type.description: What the block is; the other fields depend on it.

kind.description: The ruled pattern (Lineatur) kind: its line pattern and school level, one of the RULINGS keys, such as "l1" for Lineatur 1 (Klasse 1). Required.

color.description: The colour of the lines, as a six digit hex colour such as #1a56db.

text.description: Text printed on the lines, in the block's font. Left out, the lines stand alone.

font.description: The font of the text printed on the lines. Left out, the default font is used.

trace.description: Trace text the pupil writes over: true for grey, "outline" or "dotted". Left out, no trace.

fade.description: How the trace fades as the pupil writes on: "row" along each row, "rows" from row to row. Left out, it does not fade.

list.description: Takes its words from the sheet's words to learn (Lernwörter), one to a row, in the way the mode says. Left out, no list.

from.description: Index of the first word to learn the block shows, counted from 0, so a ruled pattern run on over several pages picks up where the last one stopped. Left out, 0.

folds.description: Number of empty columns to write in on a fold sheet (Knickblatt), after the words. 2 or 3. Any other value gives 2.

house.description: Draws a house on the lines of a kind with zones, marking its room, roof and cellar. Left out, no house.

houseTint.description: Tints the house: "room" for the room alone, "all" for roof, room and cellar. Left out, the house is not tinted.

band.description: Whether the middle band between the lines is tinted. Left out, the kind's own default applies.

bandColor.description: The band's colour, as a six digit hex colour such as #ffe066. Left out, the line colour, paler, is used.

syllables.description: Draws an arc under each syllable of the text on the lines. Left out, no arcs.

breaks.description: The word breaks set by hand for the text on the lines. They win over the sheet's breaks. Left out, the sheet's apply.

tints.description: Two colours, such as #1a56db and #e02424, that colour the syllables in turn. Left out, no colour.

tintsAcross.description: Carries the colour turn on from word to word, instead of starting again with each word. Left out, it starts again.

fields.description: The words of the name line in order, such as "Name", "Datum" and "Klasse". Left out, the line uses FIELDS.

max.description: The most points the task gives, printed in the box.

total.description: Marks the box as the sheet's total: it shows the sum of all the task boxes. Left out, it is a task box.

code.description: The OpenMoji code of the symbol, its file name in the symbol set, such as "270F" for a pencil. See SYMBOLS for all of them.

upload.description: The id of the uploaded picture file, as the server stores it.

ratio.description: The picture's width over its height, from the picture as uploaded. 1 for a square.

cut.description: Four numbers for the share cropped off the left, top, right and bottom: each a fraction of the picture, 0 for none.

opacity.description: How solid the picture prints: 1 for full strength, 0 for see-through. Left out, 1.

x.description: The upright guide lines, each the distance in mm from the paper's left edge.

y.description: The flat guide lines, each the distance in mm from the paper's top edge.
